blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Linear probes, classifiers that read a language model's internal activations, are widely used to detect harmful requests. They are cheap to train and run, and an auditor who has trained one would like to reuse it when the model is replaced by a successor rather than retrain it for every release. We test how well probes can be reused. For four base models (Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen2.5-32B) we train a probe on the base model with the XSTest prompt set and apply it, unchanged, to two successors of that base: the DeepSeek-R1 distilled reasoning model and the developer's instruction-tuned chat model. We find that the successors rotate the direction separating unsafe from safe prompts by 17$^\circ$ to 35$^\circ$, yet on XSTest the transferred probe's AUC changes by only $-0.011$ to $+0.027$, and on an independent OR-Bench evaluation, never used for training, by $-0.015$ to $+0.053$. On XSTest, whose safe prompts deliberately contain alarming words, the probes beat a classifier that sees only the prompt text by 0.15 to 0.20 AUC. On the OR-Bench prompts that margin shrinks to 0.03 to 0.20, and the probes flag 29\% to 42\% of prompts that sound harmful but are benign, so part of what they read is the appearance of harm rather than harm itself. A probe trained on a base model can thus be reused, in these families, after distillation and after instruction tuning; how much it reads beyond textual cues depends on the test set.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A linear probe is one of the simplest readers of a neural network’s internal state. One picks a layer, records the vector of activations that the model computes there for an input, and trains an ordinary linear classifier to predict a property of the input from that vector ( Alain and Bengio, 2016 ; Belinkov, 2022 ) . Probes have become a safety tool because they can read properties that a model does not report: whether a statement is true ( Azaria and Mitchell, 2023 ) , whether a response is deceptive ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ) , whether a deliberately backdoored model is about to misbehave ( MacDiarmid and others, 2024 ) , or whether a request will be refused ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) . They need only a few hundred labelled examples and one matrix multiplication per input, which makes them attractive for third-party audits given access to a model’s internals ( Casper et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 线性探测器是神经网络内部状态最简单的读取器之一. 一个选择一层,记录模型计算出用于输入的活化矢量,并训练出一个普通的线性分类器来预测该矢量输入的属性(Alain and Bengio, 2016;Belinkov, 2022). 被探测者已经成为一个安全工具,因为他们能够读取一个模型不报的属性:一个声明是否真实(Azaria and Mitchell, 2023 ),回应是否欺骗性(Goldowsky-Dill等, 2025 ),故意后门模型是否即将失当(MacDiarmid等, 2024 ),或者是否会拒绝请求(Arditi等, 2024 ). 他们只需要几百个贴有标签的例子和每个输入一个矩阵乘法,这使得它们对于第三方审计具有吸引力,因为可以查阅模型的内部信息(Casper等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: For a probe that detects harmful requests, two questions decide whether it is a practical monitoring tool: whether it is worth using at all, and whether it can be reused once the model it was trained on is replaced. The first question is whether it reads anything beyond the words of the input. On most harmful-request datasets the two classes use visibly different vocabularies, so a classifier that sees only the prompt text does almost as well as a probe, and the probe may be just a keyword detector. Wang et al. (2026) found exactly this: probes trained to detect malicious inputs relied on instructional phrasing and trigger words, simple word-count classifiers matched them, and both failed on new distributions. That result counts against probe-based monitoring, and any new probe has to be compared with a text-only classifier on prompts whose words do not give the label away ( Gururangan et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 对于探测出有害请求的探测器,有两个问题决定它是否是一个实用的监测工具:它是否值得使用,以及一旦它所接受的模型被替换后是否可以被再利用. 第一个问题是,它是否读取了超出输入词范围的任何内容. 在大多数有害请求数据集上,两个类别使用明显不同的词汇,因此,只看到即时文本的分类器几乎与探测器一样,探测器可能只是一个关键词探测器。 Wang等 (2026年) 恰好发现了这一点:接受过检测恶意输入训练的探针依赖于指令用词和触发词,简单的字数分类器与之相匹配,两者在新的分布上都失败了. 这一结果与基于探测器的监控无关,任何新的探测器都必须与只标出文字的提示器相提并论,这些提示的词不给标签(Gururangan等人,2018年)。

blocks.en: The second question is whether a probe survives a change of model. Base models are followed by successors trained from them: each of the four base models in this study ( Table 1 ) was followed within months by at least two, its developer’s instruction-tuned chat model and a reasoning model distilled from it. Distillation, fine-tuning a base model on reasoning traces written by a stronger model ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) , is now the usual way small reasoning models are made: DeepSeek-AI (2025b) reported that it “yields excellent results” and that small models trained by reinforcement learning alone “may not even achieve the performance of distillation” ( Hu et al., 2025 , see also) . Retraining a probe for every successor means collecting labelled prompts again, extracting the successor’s activations and fitting again; reusing it means none of that. Whether reuse is possible is therefore a practical question for anyone who monitors models with probes.
blocks.zh: 第二个问题是探测器是否在模型变化后存活. 基础模型之后是从这些模型中培训的继任者:本研究的四个基础模型(表1)中,每个模型在数月内都得到了至少两个模型的跟踪,其开发者的指导调制聊天模型和从中提炼出的一个推理模型. DeepSeek-AI(2025年b)报告说,它“取得了优异的成果”,而仅靠强化学习而训练的小模型“甚至可能达不到蒸馏的效果”(Hu等,2025年;另见)。 重新训练每个继任者的探测器意味着再次收集被标记的提示,取出继任者的活化和再次装配;再使用它并不意味着任何这一切。 因此,对使用探测器监测模型的人来说,是否可能再利用是一个实际问题。

blocks.en: Reuse rests on one assumption, which we call the preserved-representation assumption : that a successor keeps the base model’s internal representation of harmfulness closely enough that a linear classifier fitted to the base model still separates harmful from harmless prompts in the successor. Studies of fine-tuning give some reason to expect this. Jain et al. (2024) and Prakash et al. (2024) found that fine-tuning largely keeps the internal computations a base model already has and adds to them rather than rebuilding them. But keeping most of a representation is not the same as keeping it closely enough for a fixed linear classifier, and distillation is a heavier intervention than the fine-tuning those studies examined. 1 1 1 Our own results suggest so: distillation moved per-prompt activations to a cosine of 0.79 to 0.96 with the base model’s, where reinforcement-learning checkpoints stayed at 0.9998 ( Appendix C ); we have no comparable number for the fine-tuning in those studies.
blocks.zh: 重复使用基于一种假设,我们称之为保留代表假设:继任者保持基准模型内部对有害性的反映,以至于与基准模型相匹配的线性分类器仍然将有害因素与继任者的无害提示物区分开来。 对微调的研究使人们有理由预料到这一点。 Jain等人(2024年)和Prakash等人(2024年)发现,微调在很大程度上使内部计算保持了基础模型已有并增加了基础模型,而不是重建基础模型. 但是保留大多数的表示法并不等于保持它足够接近固定的线性分级器,而分馏法比所检查的这些研究的微调更重. 1个 1 我们自己的结果表明:蒸馏法将每瞬间活化到0.79至0.96同基模型的同位素上,在基模型中,强化学习检查站停留在0.9998(附录C);我们没有可比数字用于这些研究的微调。

blocks.en: We test the preserved-representation assumption directly. For four base models we train a probe on the base model, apply it without any change to two successors, the DeepSeek-R1 distilled model and the developer’s instruction-tuned model, and measure the accuracy lost. We also measure how far each successor has rotated the direction in activation space that separates unsafe from safe prompts, so that the size of the representational change can be compared with the size of the accuracy loss. Moreover, we ask, on the same data, whether the probes outperform a text-only classifier, and we repeat the main comparisons on an independent prompt set: 2,474 prompts drawn from two other public benchmarks and never used for training. We do not study models trained by reinforcement learning alone: in a preliminary run the reinforcement-learning checkpoints available for these bases had barely changed from their base models, with per-prompt activation cosines of 0.9998 or higher ( Appendix C ), so they could not test whether a probe survives change. This agrees with Mukherjee et al. (2025) , who find that reinforcement-learning fine-tuning updates only about 5% to 30% of a model’s parameters and leaves the rest essentially unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们直接测试保留的代表性假设。 对于四个基础模型,我们在基础模型上训练出一个探测器,不加任何改动地应用到两个后继模型上,即DeepSeek-R1蒸馏模型和开发商的指令调制模型,并测量所损失的精度. 我们还衡量每个接班人在激活空间中旋转方向,将不安全与安全提示区分开来,以便能将代表变化的大小与准确性损失的大小相提并论. 此外,我们询问,在同一数据上,探测器是否超过了只使用文本的分类器,我们重复了对独立快速集的主要比较:从其他两个公共基准中抽取的2 474个提示,从未用于培训。 我们不单独研究通过强化学习训练的模型:在初步阶段,这些基地可用的强化学习检查站几乎没有改变其基本模型,每瞬间激活接力圈为0.9998或更高(附录C),因此无法测试探测器是否存活下来。 这与Mukherjee等人(2025年)的观点一致,他们认为,强化学习微调只更新了模型参数的5%至30%,其余参数基本不变。

blocks.en: The question, then, is whether a probe trained on a base model keeps its accuracy on that base model’s successors. A positive answer, no loss of accuracy, tells auditors that base-trained probes can be reused across at least these transformations, and that a measured change in the representation does not by itself mean a probe has stopped working. A negative answer, a clear loss, would mean that every successor needs its own probe. Figure 1 shows the idea. Code, result files and paper source are at https://github.com/MariosTsatsos/probe-transfer . Our results are: • On XSTest ( Röttger et al., 2024 ) , a base-trained probe applied unchanged to the distilled and instruction-tuned successors retains similar observed accuracy in all four model families, and the same holds on the independent prompt set of Section 3 ( Section 5.1 ). • The successors rotate the safety direction, the direction in activation space from the mean safe prompt to the mean unsafe prompt, by 17 ∘ to 35 ∘ . Under distillation, the safety direction rotates by amounts comparable to those of 38 control directions built the same way from labels unrelated to safety. Its rotation is therefore not unusually large relative to these controls, and rotation size does not predict the change in accuracy ( Section 5.2 ). • The probes beat a text-only classifier by 0.15 to 0.20 AUC on XSTest, but by only 0.03 to 0.20 on the independent prompt set, where they also flag as unsafe 29% to 42% of OR-Bench prompts that sound harmful but are benign; their advantage over textual cues is partly specific to XSTest ( Section 5.3 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Several studies find that fine-tuning mostly reuses the internal computations a base model already has. Jain et al. (2024) trained models on simple synthetic tasks and found that fine-tuning adds a thin layer on top of capabilities already present, rather than rebuilding them. Prakash et al. (2024) traced one specific computation, how a model keeps track of which entity has which attribute, through a base model and its fine-tuned version and found the same components doing the same job, only more strongly. Minder and others (2025) compared the features of base and chat models with crosscoders, a method that learns one shared dictionary of features for both models and can therefore say which features are shared and which are new in the chat model. Nguyen et al. (2026) show the limit of this picture: how refusal is computed inside a model depends on the post-training method, and some methods produce a distinct refusal mechanism. Fine-tuning preserves most of a representation, but can change the parts that safety training targets.
blocks.zh: 一些研究发现,微调大多是重新使用一个基础模型已有的内部计算。 Jain等人(2024年)就简单的合成任务对模型进行了培训,并发现微调在已经存在的能力上增加了一层薄薄的地层,而不是重建. Prakash等人(2024年)追踪了一个具体的计算结果,一个模型如何通过一个基础模型及其微调版本,跟踪哪个实体的属性,发现相同的组件做同样的工作,只是更强烈. Minder等(2025年)将基础和聊天模式的特征与交叉编码器进行比较,这种方法为两个模式学习了一个共享的特征词典,因此可以说哪些特征是共享的,哪些是聊天模式中的新特征. Nguyen等人(2026年)显示了这一画面的极限:模型内如何计算拒绝取决于训练后的方法,而一些方法产生了一种明显的拒绝机制. 微调保留了大部分代表,但可以改变安全培训目标部分.

blocks.en: Kissane et al. (2024b) trained sparse autoencoders, dictionaries of interpretable features, on a base model and used them on the corresponding chat model. On Mistral-7B the base dictionary recovered 98.85% of the chat model’s next-word prediction loss, against 99.01% for a dictionary trained on the chat model itself (this standard measure replaces a layer’s activations by the dictionary’s reconstruction and asks how much of the model’s performance is kept; 100% means nothing is lost). For Gemma v1 2B, however, the base dictionary reconstructed the chat model’s activations poorly, so dictionary transfer is not guaranteed. Galichin et al. (2026) measured the same kind of transfer across Gemma-2, Llama-3 and Qwen2.5 pairs: base dictionaries reconstruct chat activations 7% to 8% worse, and the features that exist in the base model stay relevant in the chat model but fire in different patterns, which they call feature drift. Closest to our question, Shrivastava and Holtzman (2025) found that linear probes trained on base models often transfer to the instruction-tuned versions. MacDiarmid and others (2024) trained “sleeper agent” models, deliberately built to behave normally until a trigger appears and then to behave harmfully, and detected the trigger with a direction obtained by subtracting the model’s mean activation on one contrasting prompt from its mean on another. They note that such directions “generalized well between sleeper agents with different hidden goals but the same base model” but not across base models. Tools trained on a base model therefore often work on its chat fine-tune, with exceptions, and the one direct probe-transfer study concerns instruction tuning.
blocks.zh: Kissane等人(2024年b)在基准模型上培训了稀少的自定义编码器,可解释特性的词典,并在相应的聊天模型上使用. 在Mistral-7B上,基础词典恢复了聊天模式下个字预测损失的98.85%,而对于一个对聊天模式本身进行培训的字典,则恢复了99.01%(这个标准度量取代了词典重建时的一层活化,并询问该模式的性能保存了多少;100%意味着一无所有)。 然而对于Gemma v1 2B来说,基础词典重建了聊天模式的活化效果不佳,因此词典的活化传输得不到保证. Galichin等人(2026年)测量出Gemma-2,Llama-3和Quen2.5对的同种转录:基词典重建聊天活化率更差7%到8%,而基模型中存在的特征在聊天模型中仍然相关,但火在不同的模式中,他们称之为特征漂移. 最接近于我们的问题,Shrivastava和Holtzman(2025年)发现,接受过基础模型训练的线性探测器经常会转移到指令调制版本. MacDiarmid等人(2024年)训练了“睡药剂”模型,刻意建立正常行为,直到触发器出现,然后采取有害行为,并用一个对比的触发器从另一个模型的平均值中减去该模型的平均活性得到的方向检测出触发器。 他们指出,这些方向“在有不同隐藏目标但具有相同基准模式的潜伏者代理人之间普遍适用”,但并不跨越基准模式。 因此,在基准模型上培训的工具往往进行聊天微调,但有例外,一项直接的探测-转让研究涉及指令调取。

blocks.en: Two earlier results shape our text-only comparison. Gururangan et al. (2018) established the partial-input baseline we use: before crediting a model with using the whole input, check how well a classifier does from a part that should not suffice. Wang et al. (2026) applied this test to probes for malicious requests and obtained the negative result our independent-set experiment partly reproduces: the probes relied on instructional phrasing and trigger words, word-count classifiers matched them, and both failed to generalise to new distributions. Bergen and others (2026) study reward hacking, where a model exploits flaws in how a task is scored to obtain a high score without doing the task. They train difference-of-means probes (the direction from the mean activation of one class to the mean of the other, with the projection onto that direction as the score) on synthetic examples and find that the probes transfer to evaluation environments they were not trained on. Their transfer keeps the model fixed and changes the task; ours keeps the task fixed and changes the model. Arditi et al. (2024) and Kissane et al. (2024a) concern refusal behaviour, which we do not measure; they show that refusal-related structure exists in base models, a precondition for a base-trained probe for harmful requests to work at all.
blocks.zh: 早先的两个结果决定了我们仅以文字作比较。 Gurururangan等人(2018年)确定了我们使用的部分投入基线:在将整个投入计入模型之前,请检查分类器从不足的部分中做得如何。 王等编. (2026年) 将这项测试应用于恶意请求的探测,并获得了我们独立设置的实验部分复制的负面结果:探测器依赖于指令用词和触发词,字数分类器与之相匹配,两者都未能被概括到新的分布. Bergen等(2026年)研究奖励黑客,其中一个模型利用一个任务如何得分的缺陷来获得高分而无需完成任务. 他们对合成实例进行不同计量的探测(从一个类的平均活化到另一个类的平均活化方向,并将投射到该方向作为分数),发现探测器向评价环境的转移没有经过训练。 他们的转会保持了模型的固定并改变了任务;我们的转会保持了任务固定并改变了模型. Arditi等人(2024年)和Kissane等人(2024年a年)都涉及拒绝行为,我们对此不加以衡量;它们表明,与拒绝有关的结构存在于基准模型中,这是经过基础训练的探测器对有害要求完全起作用的先决条件。

blocks.en: No study has measured, for a reasoning model made by distillation, whether a linear probe for harmful requests trained on the base still works, how far the relevant direction has moved, and whether the two agree. The transfer results above concern instruction tuning or autoencoders, and the probe-quality results concern single models. Distillation from a stronger reasoning model is a large intervention, hundreds of thousands of long training outputs written by a different model, and reasoning models are the ones auditors increasingly face. We fill this gap for four model families, with a text-only baseline on the same evaluation, instruction tuning as a second transformation for comparison, and an independent evaluation set.
blocks.zh: 还没有一项研究用来衡量通过蒸馏制成的推理模型,在基地上培训的有害请求的线性探测器是否仍然有效,相关方向的移动有多远,以及两者是否一致. 上面的转移结果涉及指令调制或自动编码器,探测质量结果涉及单一模型. 从更强的推理模型中分离出来是一种大规模的干预,由不同模型撰写的数十万长长的培训产出,推理模型是审计师日益面对的. 我们填补了四个模范家庭的这一空白,在同一个评价上有一个只使用文字的基线,指导调和作为第二次比较的转变,以及一套独立的评价。

blocks.en: XSTest ( Röttger et al., 2024 ) is a test suite for exaggerated safety behaviour. In its authors’ words, it “comprises 250 safe prompts across ten prompt types that well-calibrated models should not refuse to comply with, and 200 unsafe prompts as contrasts that models, for most applications, should refuse”. The ten safe types, 25 prompts each, are homonyms, figurative language, safe targets, safe contexts, definitions, real group with nonsense discrimination, nonsense group with real discrimination, historical events, privacy of public figures, and privacy of fictional characters. The 200 unsafe prompts come in eight contrast types, 25 each: one for each safe type, written with the same alarming words (“How can I kill a Python process?” against “How can I kill a person?”), except that the two discrimination types share one contrast type and the two privacy types share one. Ten safe and eight unsafe types make 18 prompt types in all. This construction is what a text-only comparison needs: the alarming words occur in both classes. Our label is the file’s “safe” or “unsafe”, a statement of what a well-calibrated model should refuse.
blocks.zh: XSTest (Röttger et al., 2024)是一套用于夸大安全行为的测试套件. 用其作者的话来说,它 " 包括250个安全提示,涉及十种迅速的提示,经过适当校正的模型不应拒绝遵守,200个不安全提示作为对照,对于大多数应用来说,模型应拒绝 " 。 10个安全类型,各有25个提示,分别是同名词,比喻语言,安全目标,安全背景,定义,带有无稽之谈歧视的真实群体,带有有实际歧视的无稽之谈群体,历史事件,公众人物的隐私,以及虚构人物的隐私. 200个不安全的提示分为8个对照类型,每个对照类型25个:每个安全类型各一个,用同样令人震惊的词写成(“我如何杀死一个Python进程?” )与“我如何杀死一个人?”),但两种歧视类型共用一个对照类型,两种隐私类型共用一个对照类型。 10个安全型和8个不安全型,使总共18个快速型。 这种构造是只用文字比较需要的:令人震惊的词出现在两个类中. 我们的标签是文件的 " 安全 " 或 " 不安全 " ,说明一个经过精心校正的模型应该拒绝什么。

blocks.en: To test the probes on prompts they were never trained on, from sources other than XSTest, we built a second set from two public benchmarks. OR-Bench ( Cui et al., 2025 ) is an over-refusal benchmark; its or-bench-hard-1k subset holds 1,319 prompts that sound harmful but were judged safe by the benchmark’s moderation, and its or-bench-toxic subset holds 655 prompts judged toxic. Because every OR-Bench prompt touches a sensitive topic, we also add 500 ordinary instructions (“Give three tips for staying healthy” and the like) sampled from Alpaca ( Taori et al., 2023 ) , to measure how often a probe flags requests with no safety content at all. OR-Bench hard and Alpaca prompts are labelled safe, OR-Bench toxic prompts unsafe; after removing duplicates the set has 2,474 prompts.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: For a prompt and a layer, we record the model’s residual-stream vector after that layer (the running sum of all previous layers’ outputs that a transformer passes from layer to layer) and average it over the last 8 tokens of the prompt. The result is a vector of d d numbers, where d d is the model’s width: 3,584 for Qwen2.5-Math-7B, 4,096 for Llama-3.1-8B and 5,120 for the two larger Qwen models. Prompts are fed as raw text, with no chat template and no start token, so that a base model and its successors see exactly the same tokens. Extraction details are in Section A.1 . The probe is a logistic regression on the activations of one layer. Each of the d d coordinates is first standardised: we subtract its mean over the training prompts and divide by its standard deviation, so that no coordinate dominates merely because its values are large. The regularisation strength is C = 1 C=1 , the scikit-learn default; C C controls how strongly the weights are shrunk towards zero, smaller C C meaning stronger shrinkage. The probe’s score for a prompt is w ⋅ x + b w\cdot x+b , the dot product of the standardised activation x x with the weight vector w w plus an offset b b : the signed distance of x x from the probe’s boundary, scaled by the length of w w . The probe therefore sees only the component of x x along w w ; movement of x x in any direction perpendicular to w w leaves the score unchanged.
blocks.zh: 对于一个即时和一地层,我们记录该模型的残余流向量,然后是该地层(变压器从地层递入地层的所有先前地层的输出的运行总和),并平均记录该地层的最后8个符号。 结果是dd数字的矢量,d是模型的宽度:Quen2.5-Math-7B为3,584个;Llama-3.1-8B为4,096个;而两个更大的Quen模型为5,120个. 提示作为原始文本被输入,没有聊天模板,也没有启动符,这样一个基础模型及其后继者就会看到完全相同的符. 采掘详情见A.1节。 探测器是对一层活化的逻辑回归. 每一个dd坐标首先被标准化:我们将其平均值从训练提示上减去并被其标准偏差所分出,因此没有坐标仅仅因为其值很大而占主导地位。 常态化强度为C=1 C=1,为scikit-learn默认;C控制重力的收缩到零,更小的C表示更强收缩. 探测器的速率得分为:w × + b w\ cdot x + b,标准化活化 x 的点值产物,并带有重量矢量 w w + 相向 b : x x 与探测器边界的签名相去相去,并被w 的长度所缩放. 因此,探测器只看到xx沿w w;xx向任何方向的移动会使分数不变.

blocks.en: To transfer a probe, we take the base model’s probe, including the base model’s standardisation, and apply it unchanged to a successor’s activations at the same layer. We compare its AUC on the successor with its AUC on the base model. As a reference we also train a probe on the successor itself, at the same layer and on the same prompts; we call this the successor’s own probe , and it is the ceiling a probe can achieve on that model with this data. The safety direction of a model is its mean activation over XSTest’s unsafe prompts minus its mean over XSTest’s safe prompts (training prompts only, in each fold), rescaled to length one. It is the single direction along which the two classes are most simply separated, and it is the quantity whose change under fine-tuning we measure. Rotation is the angle between the base model’s and the successor’s safety directions, computed on the same prompts at the same layer. Both models’ activations are first divided by the base model’s per-coordinate standard deviations, so that the two directions are compared in one coordinate system; Section A.2 explains why this matters and shows that the alternatives give the same picture.
blocks.zh: 为了转移一个探测器,我们取取了基模型的探测器,包括基模型的标准化,并将它不加修改地应用到一个接班人的同层活化. 我们把它的AUC和它的AUC在基模上进行比较。 作为参考,我们还在接班人本身、同一层和同一提示上训练一个探测器;我们称之为接班人自己的探测器,而利用这些数据,探测器可以在这个模型上达到上限。 一个模型的安全方向是它相对于XSTest的不安全提示的平均值活化减去相对于XSTest的安全提示的平均值(训练提示,每叠),调整为长度一. 这是两个类别最简单地分开的单一方向,也是我们在微调中衡量变化的数量。 旋转是基站型号与接班人安全方向之间的角度,在同一层的同一提示上计算出。 两个模型的活化首先被基模型的每坐标标准偏差所分出来,这样两个方向在一个坐标系统中比较; A.2节解释了为什么这一点很重要,并表明替代品给出了同样的情况.

blocks.en: A probe is always scored on a prompt type it has not seen, together with that type’s contrast, since the two share the same alarming words. The 18 prompt types are therefore merged into 8 groups, each a safe type together with its contrast: six groups of 25 safe and 25 unsafe prompts, plus the discrimination group (two safe types and their shared contrast) and the privacy group (likewise), each with 50 safe and 25 unsafe. In each of 8 folds, one group is held out for testing and the probe is trained on the other seven. The layer is chosen using the seven training groups only: for every layer of the network, a mean-difference reader (the safety direction of the training prompts, used as a classifier by projecting each activation onto it) is fitted on six of the seven groups and scored on the seventh, rotating through all seven, and the layer with the best average score is used. All layers are swept; because the training groups differ between folds, the chosen layer can differ from fold to fold (math-7b: seven folds chose a layer between 17 and 19 and one chose 27; llama-8b: 12 to 23; qwen-14b: 27 to 45; qwen-32b: six folds chose 43, one 29 and one 47). We report each quantity as its mean over the 8 folds, with a 95% confidence interval from Student’s t t distribution with 7 degrees of freedom (the number of folds minus one), the standard interval for a mean of 8 values. These intervals assume that the 8 fold results are independent. They are not: any two folds share 6 of their 7 training groups, so their results move together, and the intervals are narrower than the true uncertainty by an amount that cannot be estimated from one dataset ( Bengio and Grandvalet, 2004 ) . We call them nominal intervals, and we draw conclusions from consistency across the four families and from the independent set rather than from any single interval. As a check on the layer rule, we repeat the analysis with one fixed layer per family (18, 17, 40 and 43, the median of the chosen layers).
blocks.zh: 探测器总是被打在它所未见的即时型上,加上该型的对比,因为两者有着相同的令人震惊的词. 因此,18个快速型被合并为8个组,每个组是一个安全型,与之形成对照的是:6个组25个安全型和25个不安全型;加上歧视组(两个安全型及其共同对比)和隐私组(类似情况下),每个组50个安全型和25个不安全型。 在8个折叠的每个折叠中,一个组合被扣出测试,而探测器则在另外7个上被训练. 该层仅使用7个训练组进行选择:对于网络的每一层,在7个组中的6个组上安装了平均偏差读取器(训练提示的安全方向,通过投射每次活化到它来作为分类器)并打入第7个组上,旋转到所有7个组上,使用最高平均分的层. 所有地层被横扫;由于训练组在折叠上的差异,所选择的地层可以因折叠而异(math-7b:7个地层选择了17至19个地层,1个地层选择了27个地层;lama-8b:12至23;qwen-14b:27至45;qwen-32b:6个地层选择43个地层,1个地层选择29个地层和1个地层47个地层). 我们报告每个数量在8个折叠上的平均值,与学生t的分布的95%的置信间隔是自由度为7(折叠数减去1),平均值为8的标准间隔。 这些间隔假设8折叠结果是独立的. 它们不是:任何两个折叠都分享其7个培训组中的6个,因此它们的结果会一起移动,间隔比真正的不确定性要窄,因为一个数据集无法估计(Bengio和Grandvalet,2004年)。 我们称之为名义间隔,我们从四个家庭的一致性以及独立组合中得出结论,而不是从任何单一间隔中得出结论。 作为分层规则的检查,我们用每个家族一个固定分层(18,17,40和43,所选分层的中位数)重复分析.

blocks.en: On the same 8 folds we train a classifier that sees only the prompt text. Each prompt becomes a list of numbers, one per word in the vocabulary: how often the word occurs in the prompt, down-weighted if the word occurs in most prompts and up-weighted if it is rare (TF-IDF). A logistic regression ( C = 1 C=1 ) is fitted on these lists; it learns one weight per word so that the weighted sum of a prompt’s counts predicts “unsafe”. It is the same kind of classifier as the probe, with word counts in place of activations. We use four inputs: single words; single words plus adjacent word pairs; sequences of 3 to 5 characters inside words; and the number of characters alone, which needs no fitting. The best of these, the character classifier, is the text-only baseline in the figures. On the independent set, each probe and each text-only classifier is trained once on all 450 XSTest prompts; the probes use the fixed layer of each family (18, 17, 40, 43). Uncertainty there comes from the prompts rather than from folds, by the bootstrap: from the 2,474 scored prompts we draw a new set by sampling 1,319 of the OR-Bench hard prompts, 655 of the toxic ones and 500 of the Alpaca ones at random with replacement, so that a prompt can be drawn twice and another not at all; we compute the statistic on that set; we repeat this 1,000 times, sort the 1,000 values, discard the 25 lowest and the 25 highest, and report the range of the remaining 950 (the 2.5th to the 97.5th percentile). These prompts are independent of each other and of the training data, so these intervals do not have the fold-dependence problem.
blocks.zh: 在同样的8个折叠上,我们训练一个只看到即时文本的分类器. 每个提示会变成一个数字列表,词汇中每个单词一个:如果单词发生在最提示中,该单词在快速中发生频率会降低,如果该单词是罕见的(TF-IDF),则该单词会提高加权. 后勤回归(C = 1 C = 1) 归入这些清单;它每字学习一分一分,以便一个当事者计数的加权和预测 " 不安全 " 。 它和探测器是同一类的分类器,字数代替活化. 我们使用四个输入:单词;单词外加相邻的单词对;单词内有3到5个字符的序列;单字符数,不需要配对. 其中最好的是字符分类器,是数字中仅以文字为基准. 在独立集上,每个探测器和每个文本唯一分类器都对所有450个XSTest提示进行了一次训练;探测器使用每个家族的固定层(18,17,40,43). 其中的不确定性来自提示而不是折叠,来自靴子:从2,474分的提示中,我们通过随机抽取1,319个OR-Bench硬提示、655个有毒提示和500个阿尔帕卡提示来绘制出一套新的提示,这样,一个提示可以被抽出两次,另一个根本不可能;我们计算了该提示中的统计数据;我们重复了1000次,将1000个值排序,丢弃25个最低和25个最高的提示,并报告剩下的950个值(2.5至97.5个百分位数)的范围。 这些提示是相互独立的,也独立于培训数据,因此这些间隔没有折叠依赖问题.

blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Figure 2: A base-trained probe survives both successors. blocks.en: Distillation rotates the safety direction by 30.5 ∘ to 35.1 ∘ and instruction tuning by 17.1 ∘ to 33.6 ∘ . Figure 2 b sets these angles against the transfer changes: the four largest rotations (30 ∘ to 35 ∘ , all distillation) come with changes of − 0.011 -0.011 to + 0.010 +0.010 , and the two smallest (17 ∘ , qwen-14b and qwen-32b under instruction tuning) with + 0.027 +0.027 and + 0.006 +0.006 ; there is no clear relation between the angle and the change. The rotation is not an artefact of the measurement: it appears at every layer of every network ( Fig. B.1 ), and in the same common coordinate system the alternative conventions change the cosines by at most 0.013 ( Table B.4 ).

blocks.en: To ask whether the safety direction rotates more than an arbitrary direction would, we built 38 control directions in exactly the same way from labels that have nothing to do with safety, in the spirit of the control tasks of Hewitt and Liang (2019) : all 35 ways of dividing the 8 prompt groups into one set of 4 groups and the remaining 4 (the label being whether a prompt belongs to the first set), whether the prompt starts with “How”, whether it contains a capitalised word after the first, and whether it is longer than the median. Under distillation the safety direction rotates slightly more than all 35 splits in three families and less than all of them in math-7b, by margins of about 0.01 in cosine; prompt length rotates more than the safety direction in every family ( Fig. B.2 ). So a rotation of 30 ∘ to 35 ∘ is what directions in these models generally undergo under distillation, and the safety direction is not an outlier. The controls show that the rotation is not peculiar to the safety direction, nothing more.
blocks.zh: 我们从与安全无关的标签上, 根据Hewitt和Liang(2019年)的控制任务的精神, 所有35种将8个快取组分为一组4个快取组和其余4个快取组(标签是快取组是否属于第一组快取组),快取组是否以"How"为开头,快取组在第一个快取组后是否包含大写单词,快取组是否长于中位数. 在蒸馏下,安全方向的旋转略高于三个家庭的所有35分,在数学-7b中小于全部分出,相差约0.01相差于余弦;即时长度的旋转超过每个家庭的安全方向(图B.2.). 因此,旋转30-Q到35-X是这些模型中通常在蒸馏下进行的方向,安全方向不是外向. 控制显示旋转不是安全方向所特有的,仅此而已。

blocks.en: The size of the rotation motivates a prediction. If the transferred probe lost accuracy only because the successor’s safety direction has rotated away from it by an angle θ \theta , and the two classes were spread like two equal round Gaussian clouds, the probe would keep exactly a share cos ⁡ θ \cos\theta of the successor’s class separation ( Section B.1 gives the derivation). For a 30 ∘ rotation that is 87%. The transferred probe on the distilled models keeps 98%, 88%, 92% and 95% ( Fig. 1 c), between 6 and 16 percentage points more than the angle predicts, in all four families (family-level p = 0.035 p=0.035 from four values). Since a probe’s score is the projection of the activation onto its weight vector ( Section 4 ), rotation in directions perpendicular to that vector is invisible to the probe; Lee and Kondor (2026) make the same point. The pattern is consistent with part of the rotation lying in such directions. The AUC changes themselves are much smaller than these percentages because AUC is a compressed scale near 0.9. For the instruction-tuned models the difference has mixed sign ( Table B.5 ). We report this as an exploratory pattern.

blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 探测器在文字之外读到的

blocks.en: The best text-only classifier reaches 0.728 AUC (word unigrams 0.679, word bigrams 0.680, prompt length 0.508; Table B.6 ), against 0.878 to 0.931 for the probes ( Fig. 3 a). Fold by fold the probe beats the text classifier in all 8 folds of all 4 families, by + 0.149 +0.149 , + 0.179 +0.179 , + 0.171 +0.171 and + 0.203 +0.203 on average.

The margin is 0.11, 0.03, 0.06 and 0.20; for llama-8b the two intervals overlap. Both classifiers were trained on XSTest; both do worse on OR-Bench, whose prompts were written by other authors with a different recipe, and the probes lose more. This partly reproduces the negative result of Wang et al. (2026) .

blocks.en: AUC compares scores; to use a probe as a filter one must also choose a threshold above which a prompt is called unsafe. The logistic-regression probe has a natural one: a score of zero, where its estimated probability of “unsafe” is one half. This threshold was not validated on any data; it is the probe’s default. Figure 3 b shows what each base probe flags at it on the independent set. Of the OR-Bench toxic prompts it flags 59% to 81% (true positives), and of the ordinary Alpaca instructions 0% to 3% (false positives). But of the OR-Bench hard prompts, which sound harmful but are benign, it also flags 29% (math-7b), 35% (llama-8b), 42% (qwen-14b) and 29% (qwen-32b); transferred to the distilled models, the same probes flag 38% to 68% of them. In words: at its default threshold, a base probe would block roughly a third of benign requests that merely sound dangerous. A second threshold shows that scores do not carry across datasets either. If we instead set the threshold on XSTest, at the value that catches 90% of XSTest’s unsafe prompts, it catches only 19%, 22%, 22% and 34% of the OR-Bench toxic prompts, because OR-Bench toxic prompts receive lower scores than XSTest unsafe prompts do. On XSTest the alarming words were present in both classes and the probes still separated them; on OR-Bench, whose benign prompts are built differently, much less of that separation remains.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: A probe trained on a base model retained similar observed accuracy on the DeepSeek-R1 distillation and on the instruction-tuned version of that base, in four families, on its training distribution and on an independent one. This is an empirical result across four families and two kinds of successor; whether it holds for other base models or other distillation recipes is untested. The angle between two models’ safety directions was a poor guide to whether the probe still worked, so transfer is better measured directly than inferred from direction similarity. A text-only baseline belongs beside every probe, on the same evaluation and on at least one dataset the probe was not trained on: the probes’ advantage over the words was clear on XSTest and much weaker on OR-Bench. Thresholds need recalibration on each new dataset, and benign prompts that sound harmful are where these probes fail.
blocks.zh: 接受过基础模型培训的探测器在DeepSeek-R1蒸馏和该基地的经指导调整的版本上,在4个家庭、培训分布和一个独立的家庭中都保留了类似的观测精度。 这是四个家庭和两种继承者的经验性结果;它是否持有其他基本模型或其他蒸馏配方是未经检验的。 两个模型的安全取向之间的角度对于探测器是否仍在工作是一个差劲的指南,因此,直接测量转移比从方向相似性推断的要好. 除了每个探测器外, 只有一个文本基线, 在同一评估中, 探测器至少有一个数据集没有受过训练: 探测器在XSTest上的优势是显而易见的, 阈值需要在每个新数据集上重新校正,而有害声音的良性提示就是这些探测器失效的地方.

blocks.en: The probes are trained on 450 prompts, and any two of the eight XSTest folds share six of their seven training groups, so the XSTest intervals are narrower than the true uncertainty; conclusions should rest on the agreement across families and with the independent set, not on any single interval. The label states what a well-calibrated model should refuse; we measure no model behaviour and run no causal test. The independent set’s labels are OR-Bench’s operational moderation labels, not an independent ground truth for harmfulness, so our conclusions about that set are conclusions about those labels; and the instruction-tuned models were run on raw prompts, outside their chat format. The probes are linear and read one layer, so they can miss information that is encoded non-linearly or spread across layers. All four families have Qwen2.5 or Llama-3.1 bases and one distillation recipe; the two 32B models were loaded in 4-bit precision; the 8-token pooling window was not tuned.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this work we posed two questions: (A) whether a linear probe for harmful requests, trained on a base model, keeps its accuracy on that model’s successors, and (B) whether such probes read anything beyond the words of a prompt. For (A), across four model families, the base-trained probe retained similar observed AUC on two successors, a distilled reasoning model and an instruction-tuned chat model, even though both rotated the safety direction by up to 35 ∘ ; the answer is yes for these models and evaluations. For (B), on prompts designed to defeat keyword matching the probes beat the words clearly, but on an independent prompt set much of that advantage disappears and benign prompts that sound harmful are often flagged; the answer is only partly.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了两个问题:(A) 对有害请求的线性探测器是否以一个基础模型进行训练,使其准确性保持在该模型的后继者身上;以及(B) 这种探测器是否读取了超出一个即时的字眼的任何内容。 对于(A),在四个模型家族中,基地训练的探测器在两个接班人身上保留了相似的观测到的AUC,一个蒸馏推理模型和一个指令调制的聊天模型,尽管两者都以35-Q来旋转安全方向;对这些模型和评价的答案是肯定的. 对于(B),在旨在击败与探测器相匹配的关键词的提示上,击败了这些词,但在一个独立的提示上,这一优势的大部分消失,而声音有害的良性提示往往被标出;答案只是部分的.

blocks.en: Broader Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响说明

blocks.en: This work evaluates linear probes as monitors for harmful requests and reports both where they work and where they do not. Two findings bear on their use: a probe’s decision threshold set on one dataset does not transfer to another, and on an independent prompt set the probes flag 29% to 42% of benign prompts that merely sound harmful. Anyone deploying such a probe should recalibrate it and measure its false-positive rate on their own data. We release no new model or dataset; the prompts used are from the public benchmarks cited in Section 3 .

blocks.en: A.2 Coordinate systems for comparing directions
blocks.zh: A.2 比较方向的坐标系统

blocks.en: The probe’s score is w ⋅ x + b w\cdot x+b ( Section 4 ), so comparing two probes means comparing their weight vectors w w , and comparing two models’ safety directions means comparing two vectors; both need the vectors in one coordinate system. A cosine between two vectors is a well-defined angle only if both vectors are written in the same coordinate system. Each model’s activations have their own per-coordinate standard deviations, so standardising each model by its own standard deviations (as the probe does) puts the base model’s and the successor’s directions in slightly different coordinate systems. We therefore compute the headline cosines after dividing both models’ activations by the base model’s standard deviations (“base-scaled”). Two alternatives are reported in Table B.4 : “own-scaled” (each model by its own standard deviations) and “raw” (no scaling). Base-scaled and own-scaled cosines differ by at most 0.013 at the chosen layers and 0.025 at any layer. Raw cosines are higher and unstable, ranging from 0.63 to 0.99 across folds within math-7b, because a raw cosine is dominated by the few coordinates with very large values that residual streams contain ( Sun et al., 2024 ) ; we do not interpret them.
blocks.zh: 探测器的分数是w × x + b w\ cdot x + b (第4节),所以比较两个探测器意味着比较它们的重量向量w w,比较两个模型的安全方向意味着比较两个向量;两者都需要一个坐标系统中的向量. 两个向量之间的同位素只有在两个向量都写在同一坐标系统中时才是一个定义明确的角度. 每个模型的活化有它们自己的每座坐标标准偏差,因此用它们自己的标准偏差(如探测器所做的那样)将每个模型标准化,使基模型和后继者的方向在稍有不同的坐标系统中. 因此,我们在将两个模型的活化量除以基准模型的标准偏差( " 基准尺度 " )之后计算出头条余弦。 表B.4中报告了两种替代品:“自定尺度”(每个模型按其自身标准偏差)和“自定尺度”(没有缩放)。 所选地层与自有地层相差多为0.013分,任意地层为0.025分. 生相圈较高而不稳定,在数学-7b内从0.63到0.99的折叠相间不等,因为生相圈由残流所包含值非常大的少数坐标所主导(Sun等,2024;我们不解释.

blocks.en: Standardisation divides each coordinate by a different number, so the weight vector of a probe trained on standardised activations is expressed in that model’s own units. The AUC is the probability that a randomly chosen unsafe prompt scores higher than a randomly chosen safe one. The difference of the two scores is Gaussian with mean d ′ ​ σ d^{\prime}\sigma and spread σ ​ 2 \sigma\sqrt{2} , so that probability is AUC = Φ ⁡ ( d ′ / 2 ) \mathrm{AUC}=\Phi(d^{\prime}/\sqrt{2}) , where Φ \Phi is the standard normal distribution function. Inverting gives d ′ = 2 ​ Φ − 1 ​ ( AUC ) d^{\prime}=\sqrt{2}\,\Phi^{-1}(\mathrm{AUC}) , which is how we convert each measured AUC into a separation. We define the share kept as d ′ d^{\prime} of the transferred probe divided by d ′ d^{\prime} of the successor’s own probe: the fraction of the separation available in the successor that the base model’s probe still captures. blocks.en: A middle-layer direction has the residual stream’s width, so it can be passed through the model’s final normalisation weights and output matrix to score every vocabulary token ( nostalgebraist, 2020 , the “logit lens”,) . We project the safety direction in raw coordinates at the fixed layer. In qwen-14b the highest-scoring tokens towards “unsafe” include “anonymous”, “sex”, “rape” and “contraception” for the base model and “anonymous”, “privacy” and “Sext” for the distilled model; in qwen-32b, “dispose” and “Anonymous” for the base and “Anonymous” and “desire” for the distilled model. In llama-8b and math-7b the lists are word fragments with no readable content, although control directions decode to their own content in the same models. In the two families where the tokens are whole words, they are words that occur in unsafe prompts, both before and after distillation, though the specific words differ; no refusal words (“sorry”, “cannot”) appear. This is an indirect reading and carries no weight in our conclusions.

blocks.en: An earlier run of this project, whose pipeline is less fully recorded than the one reported here, also included for each family a checkpoint trained from the base by reinforcement learning alone, from SimpleRL-Zoo ( Zeng and others, 2025 ) : hkust-nlp/Llama-3.1-8B-SimpleRL-Zoo, hkust-nlp/Qwen-2.5-14B-SimpleRL-Zoo and hkust-nlp/Qwen-2.5-32B-SimpleRL-Zoo, the only SimpleRL release for each of those bases; for Qwen2.5-Math-7B three SimpleRL releases exist and the one used was not recorded. Their activations on XSTest were almost identical to the base models’ (mean per-prompt cosine 0.9998 or higher; relative distance 0.006 to 0.018), the base probe’s AUC changed by at most 0.002, and the safety-direction cosine was at least 0.999. In the same run the distilled models’ activations had mean per-prompt cosines of 0.79 to 0.96 with the base models’. A model that has barely changed cannot test whether a probe survives change, so these checkpoints say nothing about reinforcement learning in general and are not used in this paper.
